INVITATION TO TENDERERS

The Owner invites tenders for:

The construction of a new 60th Avenue pump station, including a new precast concrete pump chamber with one new pump, site preparation, new access roads, foundation works, an elevated electrical building, discharge piping and upgrades to the agricultural ditches. The 60th Avenue pump station is situated where the 60th Avenue corridor intersects the Serpentine River. (Project D-20667)

Contract Documents are available at:

This tender is being issued electronically through the BC Bid website (www.bcbid.gov.bc.ca) where any interested party may download the tender documents directly from the BC Bid website. No registration, tracking or other recording of tender document holders will be performed by the Owner. All addenda, or further information will be published through the BC Bid website. It is the sole responsibility of the tenderer to monitor the BC Bid website regularly to check for updates.

The Contract is based on the MMCD 2019 Edition and the City’s Supplementary MMCD (2024)
